title: On-campus vs Off-campus Housing Decision
description: I am deciding whether to live on campus or off campus for 9 months. On-campus housing costs $1500 per month and off-campus housing costs $1100 per month, both billed monthly with no upfront fee. Utilities are included in both rents, with no additional housing charges. A one-way commute to campus takes 10 minutes from on-campus housing and 40 minutes from off-campus housing. Both commutes are free. I make 10 one-way commute trips each week. I prefer lower total cost.

goals.text: Minimize total housing cost over 9 months
